cs.t: I use this keyboard:  http://goldtouch.com/p-64-goldtouch-adjustable-keyboard-blac...  (it's completely split, but the two halves are  firmly  connected). The #1 reason is that it has a minimal laptop style single column of keys to the left of BS \ ENTER etc., my biggest problem is moving my right arm from the keyboard to the mouse (all mouse alternatives I've tried are worse than a plain optical mouse). If you tent it it's  rock  solid, but I didn't find any advantage to that feature.  I do really like the variable splitting ability; I've previously used a solid base keyboard with a fixed split (and some tenting) but being able to adjust all this so it's  just  right is noticeably better.
cs.th: Ask HN: Has anybody here ever used a completely split keyboard?
